style: Avant-garde chamber-soul with heavy rhythmic dissonance. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Barbershop voice-leading colliding with dissonant quartal clusters and chromatic passing-tone tension. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Fast scat-style cabaret patter alternating with wide, melismatic interval jumps and yodel-register breakage. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Frantic 7/8 Balkan meter invaded by steady 4/4 soul-funk backbeats, abrupt dynamic dropouts, and triplet-subdivision stutters. [TIMBRE / ATMOSPHERE] Acoustic upright bass, bowed glass percussion, saturated parlor organ, and close-mic dry vocal group with sudden spatial throws. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Stiff, bureaucratic delivery of impossible events. [ANCHOR] Persistent recurring motif of a low-frequency bass pulse that accelerates and distorts with every iteration. [OPERATORS] Compress the soul-groove density while stretching the harmonic decay; hold vocal pitch constant while the tonal center shifts; force the organ to mimic woodwind transients; destabilize the 7/8 rhythm via metric modulation; rotate the anchor into a glitched stutter-loop.
lyrics: [INTRO: Sparse upright bass pulsing in 4/4. Bowed glass texture enters high in the frequency spectrum.] [PROCEDURAL NARRATION: VOICE 1 - DEADPAN] Reference ID T-880. The tesseract has consumed its fill of liquid topology. [CHORUS: Close harmony barbershop quartet, rapid patter] It drank the corners, it swallowed the depth, it hiccuped a plane where the volume was kept. [INSTRUMENTAL BRIDGE: Sudden 7/8 shift, organ stabs] [SENSORY INPUT: VOICE 2 - SHARP] Error detected in coordinate stability. The glass container is currently being ingested by the object it holds. [VERSE 1: Scat-patter delivery, rapid, clipped] Tip of the glass, rim of the frame, dimensions are warping, the base is the same. Liquid the static, liquid the void, liquid the measure that we have deployed. [VOCAL HOCKETING: Tight polyphony between singers, mimicking liquid drips] Drip. Drop. Drip. Stop. The volume of the vessel is now exceeding the volume of the geometry. [BRIDGE: Dynamic dropout, single bass note sustain] [COSMIC CLERK: VOICE 3 - ADMINISTRATIVE] Note for the log: The tesseract is displaying clear signs of intoxication, specifically regarding its rotational symmetry. Requesting recalibration of the spatial axis. [VERSE 2: Soul-groove, rhythmic funk bass, frantic scat] Pouring the space into a shallow cup, checking the math as it fills it all up. Don't look at the edges, don't look at the walls, listen to how the internal dimension falls. [CHORUS: Augmented barbershop harmony, dissonant clusters] Swallowed the depth, hiccuped the plane, the liquid topology is driving us insane. [MUTATION: The bass motif from the intro returns but is now pitch-shifted up a semitone and stuttering] [PROCEDURAL NARRATION: VOICE 1 - DEADPAN] Incident Report 99. The tesseract has attempted to walk home. It tripped over a fourth-dimensional coordinate and spilled its contents into the current fiscal quarter. [INSTRUMENTAL BREAK: High-chaos organ improvisation against a metronomic 4/4 click-track] [VOCAL PERCUSSION: Rapid-fire consonant clusters, mimicking glass-breaking sounds] K-T-P-S. K-T-P-S. The glass has shattered but the liquid remains in the shape of the container. [VERSE 3: Melismatic arc, high yodel-flip register] The geometry is drunk and the math is in tears, we have been counting for a thousand light years. If the side is the bottom, and the top is the side, where can the rest of the volume hide? [BRIDGE: Absolute silence for 3 seconds, followed by a sudden brass blast] [IDENTITY ACCIDENT: VOICE 2 - WHISPERED] The container is the liquid. The container is the liquid. [CHORUS: Massed ensemble, ecstatic urgency, barbershop lead] It drank the corners, it swallowed the depth, it hiccuped a plane where the volume was kept! [OUTRO: Bass line returns to original motif, but slowed down by 50 percent, organ playing a long, discordant drone] [ADMINISTRATIVE SIGN-OFF] Closing the file. The tesseract is resting. No further liquid intake authorized until the next orbital cycle. [FADE OUT: Slow, repetitive bass pulse, lingering glass overtone resonance, abrupt stop.]
caption: A bureaucratic exploration of a drunken, topological tesseract. The song utilizes a recursive bass anchor that degrades with every repetition, forcing the ensemble into a rhythmic clash between 7/8 Balkan odd-meter and a soul-funk 4/4 backbeat. The lyrics treat impossible geometry as a mundane administrative error, creating a dissonant, high-energy environment where the container and its liquid content become indistinguishable, resulting in a surreal, rigid, and ultimately fractured sonic structure.
